description: Uncaps FPS, boosts TPS, and bypasses V-Sync on Apple Silicon Macs.

target-fps.name: Target FPS
target-fps.description: Target frame rate. Set 0 for unlimited.

tps-multiplier.name: TPS Multiplier
tps-multiplier.description: Physics ticks per second multiplier (1x = 240 TPS, 2x = 480 TPS). Higher values improve physics accuracy at high FPS.

disable-vsync.name: Disable V-Sync
disable-vsync.description: Force-disables V-Sync. On Apple Silicon Macs this bypasses the OS-level display sync lock.

vsync-persistent.name: Keep V-Sync Disabled
vsync-persistent.description: Re-applies V-Sync bypass every frame (prevents the game from re-enabling it). macOS only.

show-fps-counter.name: Show FPS Counter
show-fps-counter.description: Display a real-time FPS counter on screen.

fps-counter-position.name: FPS Counter Position
fps-counter-position.description: Where to display the FPS counter.
